custom_instruments.manage types

Basket

Defines a basket custom instrument as a weighted list of constituents.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.Basket.

Syntax

Basket(constituents: list[Constituent | dict], normalize_by_weight: bool = False) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
constituents list[Constituent | dict] Yes A list of objects, one for each row.
normalize_by_weight bool No False True: means the total value computed above is divided by the total weight - to normalize to a total weight of 1.0. False: means that the basket prices are multiplied by weights and summed as is.

Constituent

Defines a single constituent of a basket custom instrument.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.Constituent.

Syntax

Constituent(ric: str, weight: int) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
ric str Yes The instrument being considered.
weight int Yes A numerical value multiplying the value of the default pricing field of ric.

DayBasedRollover

Defines the day-based method for creating a futures continuation contract.

The roll determination points are based purely on time and have nothing to do with comparing Volume and/or Open Interest.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.DayBasedRollover.

Syntax

DayBasedRollover(
    method: DayBasedRolloverMethod | str,
    number_of_days: int,
    months_prior: int | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
method DayBasedRolloverMethod | str Yes Method used to decide when the roll to the second contract occurs. See DayBasedRolloverMethod for the possible values.
number_of_days int Yes Number of business days used by the selected method.
months_prior int | None No None Number of months prior to the expiry month at which the roll is determined.

ManualItem

Defines a single contract and the date from which it is used in a manual rollover.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.ManualItem.

Syntax

ManualItem(month: int, year: int, start_date: OptDateTime) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
month int Yes Month of the contract.
year int Yes Year of the contract.
start_date OptDateTime Yes Date from which the contract is used.

ManualRollover

Defines the manual method for constructing a futures continuation piece by piece.

All that is required is to define consecutive contracts with the days that they should be spliced together.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.ManualRollover.

Syntax

ManualRollover(*args: ManualItem)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
*args ManualItem No Consecutive contracts, each with the date from which it is used.

Months

Defines the contract months to use when building a user-defined continuation (UDC) instrument.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.Months.

Syntax

Months(
    number_of_years: int,
    include_all_months: bool | None = None,
    start_month: int | None = None,
    include_months: list | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
number_of_years int Yes Maximum of 30 - more results in an error.
include_all_months bool | None No None Include all available months as a contract method.
start_month int | None No None Month at which the contract selection starts.
include_months list | None No None Include only selected months as contract method.

SpreadAdjustment

Defines how prices are adjusted when joining contracts in a UDC.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.SpreadAdjustment.

Syntax

SpreadAdjustment(
    adjustment: str | None,
    method: SpreadAdjustmentMethod | str,
    backwards: bool = True,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
adjustment str | None Yes None: prices are not changed at all. arithmetic: the arithmetic difference in price is used to adjust via addition/subtraction. percentage: instead of adding/subtracting from the price, a percentage adjustment is made instead.
method SpreadAdjustmentMethod | str Yes Method used to compute the basis gap between contracts. See SpreadAdjustmentMethod for the possible values.
backwards bool No True True: after retrieving all of the required futures contracts data, working out the roll dates and the basis gap adjustments that apply, the adjustments are applied working from the most recent contract backwards.

UDC

Defines a user-defined continuation (UDC) custom instrument.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.UDC.

Syntax

UDC(
    root: str,
    rollover: VolumeBasedRollover | DayBasedRollover | ManualRollover,
    spread_adjustment: SpreadAdjustment,
    months: Months | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
root str Yes This is the uppercase letter (or letters) before the month and year of the futures contract RIC code.
rollover VolumeBasedRollover | DayBasedRollover | ManualRollover Yes Method for chaining individual contracts.
spread_adjustment SpreadAdjustment Yes When joining the prices of two contracts as rollover from one to the other, the price series have to be adjusted so that the prices are continuous.
months Months | None No None Contract months to use.

VolumeBasedRollover

Defines the volume-based method for chaining individual contracts to produce UDCs.

Available as lseg.data.content.custom_instruments.manage.VolumeBasedRollover.

Syntax

VolumeBasedRollover(
    method: VolumeBasedRolloverMethod | str,
    roll_occurs_within_months: int,
    roll_on_expiry: bool = True,
    number_of_days: int = 1,
    join_at_day: int = 1,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
method VolumeBasedRolloverMethod | str Yes Method used to decide when the roll to the next contract occurs. See VolumeBasedRolloverMethod for the possible values.
roll_occurs_within_months int Yes Number of months within which the roll must occur.
roll_on_expiry bool No True If the roll conditions are not met, the roll to the next contract still occurs, but it is implemented on the expiry day of the first contract. This requires an overlap of data between the contracts. If False, the history terminates at the first point of failure to roll.
number_of_days int No 1 The default is 1, which means the roll occurs between each pair of eligible contracts on the first day where the traded volume of the second contract exceeds that of the first.
join_at_day int No 1 The default is 1. It cannot be altered when number_of_days is also 1. Otherwise it can be set to any value from 1 up to number_of_days.
